22E.1 War and defeat may be brought by God as punishment for national sins.

points: All the captains, Johanan, Jezaniah, and all the people from the least to the greatest came to Jeremiah the prophet before going into Egypt and begged him to pray to the Most High for them, that they might know the way to walk and what to do.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: Jeremiah agreed to pray and promised to declare everything the Most High answered, keeping nothing back.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: They swore the Most High would be a true and faithful witness against them if they did not obey His voice, whether good or evil, so that it might be well with them.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: After ten days the word of the Most High came to Jeremiah, and he called Johanan and all the people to hear the answer.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: The Most High told them that if they would still abide in the land He would build them and not pull them down, plant them and not pluck them up, for He repented of the evil He had done to them; He does not desire evil against His people, He only wants His laws kept.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: He told them not to be afraid of the king of Babylon of whom they were afraid, for He was with them to save them, deliver them from his hand, and show them mercies so they could return to their own land.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: If instead they refused to dwell in the land and said they would go into Egypt to see no war, hear no trumpet, and hunger for no bread, then the sword they feared would overtake them there and the famine would follow close after them, and there they would die.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: All the men who set their faces to go into Egypt would die by the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and none would remain or escape the evil He would bring; the Most High set before them life or death and told them to choose life.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: As His anger was poured out on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so His fury would be poured out on them when they entered Egypt, and they would become an execration, an astonishment, a curse, and a reproach, and see the land no more.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: The Most High plainly told the remnant of Judah to go not into Egypt, and Jeremiah warned them He had admonished them that day.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: They had dissembled in their hearts when they sent him to pray, giving a false appearance and concealing that they did not truly mean to obey; some people speak words they do not believe.

note.label: Jeremiah 42: The Remnant Seeks Counsel and the Most High Says Stay

points: Because they had not obeyed His voice, they would certainly die by the sword, the famine, and the pestilence in the very place they desired to go; we are these same people, quick to say we will not do what the Most High commands, though now that we understand who we are in these last days many of us want to keep His laws.
